title: Routing infrastructure: from OpenStreetMap to private OSRM services
subtitle: Images and checks since P012a; the deploy path and the private services since P012a2 (deployed by Rahul); the API and the app follow in P012b and P012c (ADR 0020)

groups.label: Google Cloud staging (deploy path: P012a2; API: P012b; app: P012c)

nodes.label: Geofabrik extract of OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0), dated, MD5 checked
build-image.mjs: allowlisted URL, metadata.json, image labels
Stage 1: osmium cuts the extent (state boundary relation, a box, or the sample)
Stage 2: osrm-extract, osrm-partition, osrm-customize (MLD) for foot or car
Image saferoute-osrm: one profile, graph baked in, osrm-routed as non-root, log level WARNING
state-extent.json: simplified outline for the API's inside/outside answer
osrm-ci: the whole pipeline on a 79 KB sample fixture, both profiles
local-smoke.mjs: routes between public places, limits, user, labels, NO request path in the log
measure.mjs: p50/p95, NoRoute rate, memory (seeded random points)
Cloud Run saferoute-osrm-walking: private, role-less sa-osrm-runtime, scales to zero
Cloud Run saferoute-osrm-driving: private, role-less sa-osrm-runtime, scales to zero
bootstrap-staging.ps1 -Apply (Rahul): role-less account, log exclusions, invoker for the API only
Platform request logs of both services excluded: their URLs hold coordinates
saferoute-api (sa-api-runtime): run.invoker + Google ID token, POST /v1/routes (P012b)
Android app: directions (P012c). It never calls OSRM

edges.label: IAM, coordinates in the URL path
